Rotation order is fixed by merit (ESPN depth chart). An injury never moves a player down; it only changes his tag. "Plays now" is the first healthy player in that order.

Starters are the No. 1 player at PG, SG, SF, PF and C. Return dates are estimates from the injury report, not clearance. Minutes, scoring and shooting are last-season (2025-26) baselines until this season has enough games.

Sportsbet lines come from The Odds API and player props from Sportsbet through the desktop browser, both at the times shown on Best Bets; they are the reference for every bet; DraftKings via ESPN is the fallback and the source of line movement, all shown as decimal prices; open → now shows movement since the opener. EPM, start chances, projected minutes and four-factor profiles are from Dunks & Threes (Basic tier — game score projections are not included). The "model line" is this book's own: lineup-weighted EPM with tonight's injuries, rest and home court fitted from last season's closing lines; the "EPM line" is the same without injuries. Public splits are Scores & Odds consensus; anything you record replaces it. Check your own book before betting.
